title: Texas Comptroller Active Sales Tax Permit Outlets
description: Governed Texas Comptroller active sales-tax permit taxpayer/outlet layer with privacy-minimized selected fields, source-described physical outlet addresses, NAICS, temporal permit evidence, ZIP/ZCTA context, and source-specific active semantics.
coverage_claim: Taxpayer/outlet pairs in the official Texas Comptroller Active Sales Tax Permit Holders dataset at its source refresh. Active means the outlet holds an active sales-tax permit under Texas Tax Code Chapter 151, Subchapter F; it is not independent proof of continuous operations or public access.
